name: R. B. Harrison
role: Secretary of the Montana Stockgrowers' Association
bio: R. B. Harrison was secretary of the Montana Stockgrowers' Association, elected secretary and treasurer at its April 1885 meeting and calling the roll at its fall 1885 meeting in Helena. In November 1885 he passed through Medora with President Bryan and Granville Stuart on the way to the national association meeting.
